description.value: Gage Market is a self-checkout convenience market inside the Walter Gage Residence complex on the UBC Vancouver campus, open to the general public. It carries sandwiches, sushi, snacks, beverages, and personal sundries. Entry is via a credit or debit card swipe to open a secure gate, with items automatically tallied upon exit — cash is not accepted.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 47m; anchors at 65m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at food.ubc.ca/places/gage-market/ clearly matches the OSM location at Walter Gage Residence on the UBC Vancouver campus, describing a public self-checkout market selling sandwiches, sushi, snacks, beverages, and personal sundries. OSM carries no address or phone, both of which are sourced from the website. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the site or in OSM tags; the only confirmed amenity is basic groceries per the product list on the website page.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Gage Mini Mart' but the website consistently uses 'Gage Market' throughout.
Entry and payment require a credit or debit card; cash is not accepted, which may be a barrier for some cyclists.
Address (5959 Student Union Blvd) and phone (604.822.5494) are sourced from the website — OSM carries no contact details to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A publicly accessible convenience market on the UBC campus with food and beverages useful for resupply; the card-only entry is a quirk but does not disqualify the listing.

wow_evidence: self-checkout convenience market inside the Walter Gage Residence complex
